why: Most commands are fine. `node bin/greet.js --shout Ada`, `'Grace Hopper'` and `Ada --shout` use bin/greet.js, which exists. `npm test` maps to the "node --test" script. `cat docs/index.md` and `grep -n -- '--shout' docs/index.md` are valid. `gh run list --workflow pages.yml` names a workflow that exists, and `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` is valid. The criterion breaks on the verifier's Check 4 command `gh pr view <number> --json state,mergedAt`. It would not run as written: the shell reads `<number>` as input redirection from a file named "number", which doesn't exist, so the command fails before gh starts. The verifier has to replace it with a real PR number (or drop it), so not every command the briefs give runs as written.
